customManagers.description: The archive versions the PPA's source packages are built from (tools/patched-deb/ppa-sources.yml)

packageRules.description: PPA sources: never automerge; after the merge, tools/patched-deb/ppa.sh source and upload publish the rebuild. Archive indexes carry no release dates, so no soak.
prBodyNotes: After merging: run `tools/patched-deb/ppa.sh source work/ppa/upload` and `tools/patched-deb/ppa.sh upload work/ppa/upload` on the desktop (the upload asks for the signing key's passphrase). The **PPA sources** check shows whether the patches still apply to the new version.
